card.name: Inside brand names before 'use' or 'from'
card.fires_on: Final or middle pieces of brand drug and device names (SPRAVATO, CYANOKIT, BOSULIF, CERVIDIL, ParaGard) just before words like administration, use, or at. Also the end of 'inhaler' or 'capsules' after a verb like remove.

modes.label: Split brand names
modes.description: Later pieces of an uppercase brand name written in an instruction or warning.
modes.example: Remove CERVID<<IL>> at least 30 minutes before administration

modes.label: Product nouns after remove
modes.description: The product noun such as inhaler or capsules where the product is being removed or discussed.
modes.example: remove the inhal<<er>> from the mouth

card.plain: It fires inside brand names and product words, mostly in handling or removal directions.
